components.css: .ds-visit { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-accent, #0f4c6e); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif); } .ds-visit-action { display: inline-block; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 150ms linear; } .ds-visit:hover .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:focus-visible .ds-visit-action { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-visit:active .ds-visit-action { transform: translateX(1px); opacity: 0.72; } .ds-visit-domain { font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-visit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0f4c6e); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-visit:hover .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:focus-visible .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:active .ds-visit-action { transform: none; } }

components.css: .ds-row { background: var(--color-sheet, #fbfbfc); color: var(--color-ink, #1a1d21); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d5dbe3); border-radius: 0; padding: 2.5rem 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #f3f6f8); } .ds-row-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-mark { width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; color: var(--color-accent, #0f4c6e); } .ds-row-copy { margin: 0; max-width: 38em; line-height: 1.55; }

narrative.overview:
Codewizard’s site is one sheet of paper on a cool desk, read in ordinary daylight. The studio name is the press name. Each app is a title in the imprint, with its place of publication, platform, and price on the same entry. Nothing here pretends to be a larger company, and the page does not borrow the voice of a startup hero or a card grid.

The sheet is square-cornered, set in one grotesque, and mostly quiet. Register blue is rare at rest: it marks the title that is actually in print, and the link that opens it. A title that is not ready is drawn with an empty circle and stays uninked. Motion does one job on arrival — the live mark finds its register — and after that only answers the pointer.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet, wide margins, hairline rules, lots of open paper
Carbon ink on a cool white sheet, over a slightly darker desk
One accent, register blue, used sparingly
Square corners; the only curve is the drawn register mark
Bahasa Indonesia, short lines, no second language toggle

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: At rest, register blue appears only on the live title’s mark and its visit link, plus focus. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not add a serif, a monospace costume, or a second family for “technical” details.

rules.name: The Flat Row Rule
rules.body: A product row does not float. Hover changes its wash, not its elevation.

dos: Do keep new products as imprint rows fed by `products.js`, with the same fields: name, summary, specs, https link, and domain.
Do leave one uninked “Segera hadir” row until that product has a real subdomain.
Do keep copy visible without JavaScript. The script only replaces the same list.
Do keep `prefers-reduced-motion` spatial movement off, and keep color and opacity feedback on.
donts: Don't add a second accent, a gradient, a filled pill, or a drop shadow on a row.
Don't round the sheet or turn products into icon-plus-heading tiles.
Don't set type in a monospace face to look technical.
Don't hide the register circle or the product names behind an entrance animation.
Don't imply this studio is CODE WIZARD INC or Code Wiz, and don't invent prices, platforms, or screenshots.
